topic.title: Fictional business paperwork and goods identification

assets.meaning: A document being signed, not a completed approval or legally verified contract
assets.subject: One broad upright paper sheet with two content lines and one simple pen cue. No extra desk, hands, seals or stamps.
avoid: Do not add an approval check, seal or outcome.

assets.meaning: One item identified for inventory, not proven inspected or shipped
assets.subject: One plain compact carton with a single broad identification-label cue on its front. Label uses just three simple vertical bars, no letters, digits or dense barcode.
avoid: No trolley, warehouse scene, scanner gun, shipping arrows or passed-inspection tick.
